general_tolerance: UNLESS OTHERWISE SPECIFIED: THIRD ANGLE PROJECTION; DIMENSIONS IN INCHES; 2-PLACE DIM. ±.020; 3-PLACE DIM. ±.010; ANGULAR DIM ±1°

views.description: Longitudinal external view of a solid turned adapter: large cylindrical body, reduced coaxial shank, circumferential groove and chamfered shank end. Surface shading is not section hatching.
views.centerline_notes: Horizontal centerline establishes the common axis of the body, shank, annular groove and end chamfer. No holes or hidden bore are indicated.

views.description: Right-hand end view in third-angle projection. Three concentric circles show the large body outline, shank outside diameter and reduced end diameter. These circles do not indicate a hole.
views.centerline_notes: Crossed centerlines establish a single common axis. The groove and shoulder fillet are obscured in this projection and are not drawn with hidden lines.

dimensions.notes: Left body end to right shank end. General two-place tolerance.
Shoulder to terminal end. General three-place tolerance.

Printed .500. Extension terminates in the narrow groove region. '.062 CENT.' suggests the groove is centered on this station, but the scan does not cleanly distinguish a groove-center reference from a root-edge reference. Confirm the location convention before building. Numeric value is clear.
Axial distance from start of end bevel to terminal end face. General three-place tolerance.
From '.03 × 45°' leader at the left outer edge. General two-place tolerance.
Angle and angular tolerance are in degrees; unit field retains drawing length units because the schema has no degree option. Part of '.03 × 45°'.

Printed .625 DIA. Dimension extensions indicate the reduced diameter at the terminal end. Groove root is drawn at approximately the same diameter; application of this diameter to the groove root should be confirmed because no separate groove-root diameter leader is present.
Printed .746 DIA. ±.001. Explicit tolerance overrides general tolerance.
Upper 30° callout, between the axial direction and extended end-bevel line. Values and tolerance are degrees.
Separate lower '30° TYP.' callout. Applies to the sloped groove flanks as indicated. Values and tolerance are degrees.

Printed '.062 CENT.' below the groove, with opposed arrows to closely spaced groove-region extension lines. Interpreted as the narrow root land width centered at the .500 station; confirm the centered-location interpretation against the original drawing.
Printed '.030 R. MAX.' Leader points to the body/shank shoulder root. This is an upper limit, not a nominal radius with the general ±.010 tolerance. No minimum radius is specified.
Derived, not printed: 2.12 - .875 = 1.245. Reported ±.030 is worst-case propagation of the two source tolerances, not an independent drawing tolerance.

features.description: Solid cylindrical large body, diameter 1.75 and derived axial length 1.245. Use the left end-face center as the axial origin. Not a hollow part.
Coaxial solid shank projecting .875 from the body shoulder, diameter .746 ±.001.

Subtractive full-revolution circumferential groove in the shank. Nominal .062 root width, .500 location from shoulder and 30° typical flanks. Confirm center-versus-edge location and root diameter before creating the final groove profile.

Circumferential shank-end bevel. Drawing gives .094 axial extent, 30° angle and .625 terminal diameter. These nominal values are redundant and not exactly coincident; choose a consistent within-tolerance profile rather than overconstraining the CAD sketch.
Circumferential concave fillet at the large-body/shank shoulder, radius .030 maximum. Exact design radius is not specified.
Circumferential chamfer on the large body's left outside edge, .03 × 45°.

symmetry.description: Turned geometry is symmetric about any longitudinal plane containing the common axis. Required identification stamping is excluded from this geometric symmetry.
Second longitudinal symmetry plane; no end-for-end axial symmetry is implied.

concentric_groups.description: Body, shank, groove, shoulder fillet and circumferential chamfers share the longitudinal turning axis. Established by both views; no GD&T concentricity tolerance is specified.

dimension_chains.description: Overall axial length = large-body length + shank projection: 2.12 = 1.245 + .875.

warnings: No ASME, ISO or DIN standard designation is explicitly printed. The drawing specifies third-angle projection and inches; drawing_standard is left empty rather than inferred.
Required marking: STAMP "SB-12050" on the large body's cylindrical surface as indicated by the leader. Letter size, stamp depth and exact location are not dimensioned.
Title-block supplementary data: model number 220-B; manufacturer Manufacturing Technology Inc.; date March 26, 1979; sheet size B; sheet 1 of 1. No revision or surface-finish requirement is shown.
Material note reads MAT'L. ~ 4150, R/C 40–45. Hardness is a requirement, not a dimensional tolerance.
The .500 groove-location value and .062 CENT. width are readable, but the exact center-versus-root-edge convention is not completely resolved in this scan. Confirm before finalizing the groove.
The .625 diameter is clearly called out at the reduced terminal end; using it also as the groove-root diameter is plausible from the aligned profile but should be verified.

Terminal-bevel nominal cross-check: .746 - 2(.094 tan 30°) = approximately .63746, not .625. Conversely, .746 to .625 at 30° requires approximately .10479 axial length. The tolerance ranges permit a compatible profile, but all four nominal values must not be imposed as exact CAD constraints.
The .030 R. MAX. shoulder radius specifies only a maximum; a unique nominal fillet cannot be extracted.
Angular dimension values and tolerances are degrees despite the schema's length-only unit field.
No hole, thread, datum identification, feature-control frame, geometric tolerance, section view or reference dimension is indicated.
